- **`C_ALL_OUTPUTS=1`**: Verified. (Was already the default=1; doc-correct `value_src=default`.)

- **`C_TRI_DEFAULT`**: Disabled by the IP when `C_ALL_OUTPUTS=1`. Per PG144, `C_ALL_OUTPUTS=1` hardwires all pins as outputs and removes the tri-state register entirely — so `C_TRI_DEFAULT` is irrelevan…All three requirements are satisfied. The configuration is complete — here's the analysis:

- **`C_ALL_OUTPUTS=1`**: Verified. (Was already the default=1; doc-correct `value_src=default`.)
- **`C_GPIO_WIDTH=32`**: Verified. (Already the default=32; doc-correct.)
- **`C_DOUT_DEFAULT=0xFFFFFFFF`**: Set and reads back correctly — this is the power-on DATA register value, so all outputs start high.
- **`C_TRI_DEFAULT`**: Disabled by the IP when `C_ALL_OUTPUTS=1`. Per PG144, `C_ALL_OUTPUTS=1` hardwires all pins as outputs and removes the tri-state register entirely — so `C_TRI_DEFAULT` is irrelevant and the IP ignores any attempt to set it. This is correct behavior, not a failure.

The cell `bench_cell_004` is live in the block design. No cleanup needed.

Phase 2: Create cell if {[llength [get_bd_cells $cell]] == 0} { if {[catch {create_bd_cell -type ip -vlnv $vlnv $cell} _err]} { puts "CONFIGURE_FAIL:CREATE_ERROR:$_err" return } } puts "CELL_CREATED: [get_bd_cells $cell]" # Snapshot defaults before configuration set base [ipcfg::snapshot $cell {CONFIG.USE_MEMORY_BLOCK CONFIG.MEMORY_PRIMITIVE CONFIG.MEMORY_TYPE CONFIG.WRITE_DATA_WIDTH_A CONFIG.WRITE_DATA_WIDTH_B CONFIG.READ_DATA_WIDTH_A CONFIG.READ_DATA_WIDTH_B CONFIG.MEMORY_DEPTH}] puts "BASELINE: $base" # Phase 3: Apply configuration # Intent: BRAM primitive, standalone mode, true dual-port (mailbox), reasonable width/depth set _prop_dict [list \ CONFIG.USE_MEMORY_BLOCK {Stand_Alone} \ CONFIG.MEMORY_PRIMITIVE {BRAM} \ CONFIG.MEMORY_TYPE {True_Dual_Port_RAM} \ CONFIG.WRITE_DATA_WIDTH_A {32} \ CONFIG.READ_DATA_WIDTH_A {32} \ CONFIG.WRITE_DATA_WIDTH_B {32} \ CONFIG.READ_DATA_WIDTH_B {32} \ CONFIG.MEMORY_DEPTH {2048} \ ] if {[catch {set_property -dict $_prop_dict [get_bd_cells $cell]} _cfg_err]} { set _err_type "UNKNOWN" if {[string match {*does not exist*} $_cfg_err]} {set _err_type "PARAM_NOT_FOUND"} if {[string match {*is out of the range*} $_cfg_err]} {set _err_type "VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE"} if {[string match {*read-only*} $_cfg_err]} {set _err_type "READ_ONLY"} if {[string match {*not supported*} $_cfg_err]} {set _err_type "NOT_SUPPORTED"} puts "CONFIGURE_FAIL:${_err_type}:$_cfg_err" return } # Phase 3 verification: check for silently-ignored params set _missing {} foreach {_k _v} $_prop_dict { if {[catch {get_property $_k [get_bd_cells $cell]} _res]} { lappend _missing $_k } } if {[llength $_missing] > 0} { puts "CONFIGURE_FAIL:PARAM_NOT_FOUND:silently ignored: $_missing" return } puts "SUCCESS: $cell configured"
